rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance (Chapter 260)
rules.requirement: Rent increases on covered Jersey City rental units are regulated under the city's Rent Control Ordinance, administered by the Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations. Landlords seeking increases beyond the standard limits must apply, for example for capital improvements or hardship. Tenants may file Illegal Rent Petitions.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental properties in Jersey City with 5 or more units; properties with 1-4 units are exempt from rent control.
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt. Other exemptions are available through a Rent Control Exemption Request if the owner meets the ordinance's criteria.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Other exemptions under Chapter 260 can be granted through a Rent Control Exemption Request; the page does not list the criteria.

rules.quoted_span: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)
rules.conflict_note: The page does not state the allowable increase formula. It references a Consumer Price Index chart, suggesting a CPI-based cap, but no figure is given.
